name: Vespyx
voice: sly and eager, talks in quick little hisses
desc: A sly fox with a scorpion's curled tail. Its sting drips venom that keeps eating at foes after the hit.

egg.name: Venom Egg
egg.desc: A dark plum shell beaded with green droplets. It hisses when you lean close. Something bold is in here.
egg.play: Darts in, stings hard and poisons. Brave, but quick to anger.
